subject: website
name: Team Omega Audits
summary: The site of Omega Audits, a two-person Solidity audit team. No public source for this build was found; the linked repository holds only audit reports. It is not Level 3: when it opens it loads Font Awesome's script from use.fontawesome.com with no integrity hash, third-party code that can change at any time. It also loads Google Fonts.

connections.name: Font Awesome script (use.fontawesome.com)
connections.note: Loaded when the page opens, without an integrity hash.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
